items.label: Land Surveying
items.description: We provide a wide range of land surveying services, including topographical surveys, boundary surveys, sectional properties, building site surveys, resource mapping, bathymetric surveys, hydrographic surveys, and GIS mapping. Our deliverables include boundary survey reports and plans, cadastral plans for title processing, beacons monumentation, registry maps, 3D spatial data (X, Y, Z), topographical maps, contours, CAD shapefiles, survey reports, PDF map outputs, and other specialized deliverables.

faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Straight answers from the field — the things clients ask us before commissioning their first survey.

items.question: Do I need a survey before construction?
items.answer: Yes — and it's the cheapest insurance you'll ever buy. A topographical survey feeds your architectural designs, engineering plans, and county approvals, and it surfaces site realities (slopes, utilities, boundary positions) before they become costly change orders. Building on assumptions is the most expensive mistake in construction.

items.question: How long does a survey take?
items.answer: Most projects take 1–3 days of fieldwork and 2–7 days of processing and drafting, depending on the size of the site, the terrain, and the deliverables you need. We confirm a clear timeline with your quotation — and flag any delays early, not at handover.

items.question: Can you detect underground utilities?
items.answer: Yes. We use Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) — including the LMX200 — alongside utility mapping techniques to locate buried water lines, power cables, and other infrastructure before you excavate. It protects your crew, your budget, and your programme.

items.question: How much will my survey cost?
items.answer: Boundary surveys start from KES 30,000+, topographical surveys from KES 50,000+, and drone mapping from KES 25,000+. Because every site is different, we price on size, terrain, and accessibility — request a custom quotation and we'll turn it around quickly.

items.question: Which areas do you cover?
items.answer: We're based in Nairobi (Ruiru) and work across Kiambu, Machakos, Kajiado, Mombasa, Kisumu, and Nakuru — with full crews regularly deploying to Uganda, Tanzania, Somalia, and the wider East Africa region.

items.question: What deliverables will I receive?
items.answer: Professional, ready-to-use outputs: topographical maps and contours, boundary and cadastral plans, 3D point clouds, DEM/DSM models, CAD shapefiles, orthomosaics, volumetric reports, and signed survey reports — formatted for engineers, architects, and approval authorities.
